(FAQ)

Questions

Why build instead of buying another app?

Off-the-shelf tools make you change how you work to fit them. When your team is paying for several tools and still keeping spreadsheets on the side, a custom system usually costs less over two to three years and removes the double entry.

Do we own the software?

Yes. You own the code and the data. We host and maintain it if you want us to, and hand it over if you don't.

Can you connect it to the tools we keep?

Usually. Most accounting, payment, email and calendar tools have an API we can connect to. We confirm every integration during discovery, before you commit to a build.

How long does a build take?

Most first versions take 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope. You see working software every week along the way.
